title: Spotlite plugin manifest
description: plugin.json at the top of a Spotlite plugin's folder. See docs/plugins.md.

$schema.description: This schema's address, for editor completion. Spotlite ignores it.

id.description: The plugin's id: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', up to 128 characters, not starting with '.'. Unique among installed plugins, ignoring letter case.

version.description: Shown in Settings and compared as a semantic version by Check for Updates.

description.description: One sentence about what the plugin does.

executable.description: Path of the program inside the plugin's folder, with the executable bit. Needed when a command's action is run, list or search, or a menu row's is.

timeout.description: Seconds a run may take. Values outside 1 to 60 are clamped.

commands.description: Root search results the plugin adds. Command ids must be unique.

settings.description: Configuration fields shared by all commands, shown by Configure in Settings → Plugins. Ids must be unique.

plainID.description: Letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', up to 128 characters.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name, an image file (relative to the plugin's folder unless absolute), or any other path, whose Finder icon is shown.

command.title: Command
command.description: A root search result. It ranks, hides, takes an alias and learns launch history like an app.

id.description: Unique within the plugin. Keys aliases, hiding and launch history.

title.description: The name search matches and shows.

keyword.description: Another name that finds the command, until the user sets an alias.

item.title: Row
item.description: One row of a list, search or menu. A row without an action only informs.

id.description: Tells rows apart for launch history and selection. Defaults to the title.

subtitle.description: Shown at the right of the selected row.

accessory.description: Short text at the right of every row, such as a count or a date.

keywords.description: More names that find the row when typing filters it. Only the first 8 are used.

action.title: Action
action.description: What Return, a shortcut or the action list does.

type.description: open, copy and menu run in Spotlite; run, list and search start the executable.

openAction.description: Opens a URL or a file path and closes the panel.

url.description: A URL with a scheme, or a path starting with / or ~.

copyAction.description: Copies the text and closes the panel.

runAction.description: Runs the executable and applies its response. The panel closes first unless keepOpen is set.

keepOpen.description: Keep the panel open and reload the current list after the run.

listAction.description: Enters a list the executable prints once; Spotlite filters it as you type.

searchAction.description: Enters a list the executable prints for each query, passed as the last argument.

debounce.description: Milliseconds typing must pause before a run. Values outside 0 to 2000 are clamped.

minQuery.description: Characters needed before the first run.

menuAction.description: Enters a fixed list. No process is started.

items.description: The rows. A malformed row is skipped on its own.

emptyText.description: Shown when the level has no rows. Default “No results”.

sort.description: false keeps matches in the plugin's order. Default true, best match first.

stream.description: Read one JSON object per line (NDJSON) and show rows as they arrive.

confirm.description: Ask before the action runs: a question, or an object. A malformed confirm drops the row or action rather than running it unasked.

destructive.description: Mark the button with a warning icon.

actions.description: Other actions, reached with a shortcut or from the action list (⌘K). At most 16 are read.

title.description: Shown in the action list, and on the row while the shortcut is held.

shortcut.description: Modifiers held with Return: cmd, opt, shift or ctrl, or several joined by +, such as cmd+shift. The first action to claim a chord gets it.

shortcutName.description: Every modifier name a shortcut may join. command, option, alt and control are aliases.

id.description: Key in SPOTLITE_CONFIG. Unique within the plugin.

multiline.description: A multi-line editor. The value is still one string.

numberSetting.description: A finite number, fractions included. The default must lie within min and max.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, at least min.

booleanSetting.description: A toggle, false unless a default says otherwise.

choiceSetting.description: One of the options' values. The default must be one of them.

secretSetting.description: A string kept in the Keychain, never in the settings file. Takes no default.

fileSetting.description: A file path. A leading ~ is expanded in SPOTLITE_CONFIG.

extensions.description: Extensions the Choose… panel offers, such as json. A leading dot is dropped.

folderSetting.description: A folder path. A leading ~ is expanded in SPOTLITE_CONFIG.

listSetting.description: An array of strings, edited one per line.
